description:
Step 1 of attaching the customer's finished artwork file to an order line: get a presigned upload URL.

Returns a presigned `url`, `method` (PUT), `headers`, and `object_key`.
Get `item_id` from `order_get_artwork_spec`.
PUT the raw file bytes straight to `url` with the `headers` verbatim (the
bytes never pass through Compass), then call `order_confirm_artwork_upload`
with the same `object_key`. Use for a line that has finished artwork and
needs no design from us; prefer `order_get_artwork_upload_page` when the
user has the file but you don't. Only works for orders created in this
session. Refused with `ItemDesignAttachedError` when the item of a
multi-item order already holds an attached design: that design is what
prints, and changed artwork for the item needs a new order.
name: order_request_artwork_upload

headers.description: Headers to send verbatim on the PUT — they are part of the S3 signature.

method.description: HTTP method for the PUT (usually PUT).

object_key.description: Pass this back to order_confirm_artwork_upload once the PUT succeeds.

url.description: Presigned S3 URL. PUT the raw artwork bytes here; the bytes never pass through Compass.

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Request an artwork upload slot
